about: Candidate category-pin palettes for the hue-spacing PR (design system 1.3.0). Ernest picks one; the one in use is whatever src/styles/tokens.css says. Every set keeps each pin in OKLCH L 57-67 and at least 3:1 under its white glyph, keeps the meaning anchors (first aid red 22-30 deg, food warm orange 45-62, restroom green, water blue, stage purple), keeps beverage as the darker step of drinks at the same hue (about 8 L darker, as today), and stays at least dE 10 from --ff-teal, --ff-coral and both --cat-* slates. Found by a constrained search over OKLCH (L, C, hue) per pin, then judged by eye on the swatch strips. Render: node scripts/hue-sets.mjs --render

a.title: least change (recommended)
a.note: Every pin moves only as far as it must: the fewest visible changes from today's map, every pin still recognisably itself. Drinks does not move at all, so beverage stays its clear darker step (8.2 L apart, as today). Water goes a clearer cerulean and info a truer blue, kids lightens to rose, food brightens to orange. Chroma 0.11-0.17.

b.title: vivid
b.note: The same anchors at higher chroma (up to 0.20): the widest spacing of the three, and the loudest. Info is an electric blue, kids a hot pink, food a bright orange. Drinks stays as today.

c.title: muted
c.note: Chroma capped at 0.15, nearest the printed poster's tone. Clears the rule, with the least margin of the three.

yellow.title: drinks into the yellow gap (rejected)
yellow.note: Moving drinks to hue 100 into the empty 81-159 deg stretch measures smallest dE 11.9, no better than set B, and at L 65 a yellow is olive: drinks #A2900E and beverage #8C7C04 read as mustard and khaki, not amber beer. Shown for the record.
